name: Travel agent

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Trip planning session
services.story: The main story: a $55 trip planning session by video, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Trip check-in
services.story: A $35 trip check-in: a card is saved for the $20 late-cancel fee, and the $35 is charged when the agent texts DONE.

services.name: Trip package
services.story: A $640 trip package, quoted from the trip request first: a $160 deposit now, and the $480 rest at the front desk.

services.name: Group trip meeting
services.story: A $25 group trip meeting at the office, per person: nothing is taken, and the group pays at the front desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Planning session at your home
services.story: The main story: a $179 planning session at a family's home; a card is saved for the $89 visit fee and the $179 is charged when the agent texts DONE.

services.name: Trip package at home
services.story: A $640 trip package at the family's home, quoted from the trip request: a $160 deposit now, and the $480 rest on the bill after.

services.name: Group trip meeting at a host's hall
services.story: A $179 group trip meeting at a host's hall: nothing is taken, and the bill is texted after.

services.name: Planning call at home, paid in full
services.story: A $150 planning call at home, paid in full when booking; a late cancel may keep the $89 visit fee.

services_shape: Consult: planning meetings with an agent at the office, by video or phone, or at the customer's home. The trips themselves (flights, hotels, cruises, tours, rail, travel insurance) are bought from the airlines, hotels and other suppliers outside Rosie, by the customer or through the agency's own supplier tools. Rosie books and takes payment only for the agent's own planning service.
questions_before_times: What kind of trip: a cruise, a family vacation, a honeymoon, a group or a wedding, business travel.
Roughly when, and how many travelers?
Is there a date you must book by, like a group's deadline or a sale's end?
In the office, by video or phone, or at your home?
safety_stop: someone in danger or hurt right now, at home or abroad
license: No license is needed for this work in most places. A registration or certificate the state asks for is the business's own to add. It is optional, and nothing is looked up.
messages_never: Passport numbers, dates of birth, card numbers, health and mobility needs, and when the customer's home will be empty.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
